title: Magnesium Reborn
features:
ESP Features
ESP Master Toggle - Enable/disable all ESP
Box ESP - Show boxes around players
Name ESP - Show player names
Tracer ESP - Lines from screen to players
Health Bar - Visual health bars
Show Distance - Display distance in meters
Show Health Number - Show exact HP values
Item ESP - Show items/loot
Corpse ESP - Show dead bodies
C4 ESP - Show planted explosives
Player Weapons ESP - Show equipped weapons
Aimbot Features
Aimbot Enabled - Master aimbot toggle
Aimbot FOV - Field of view circle
FOV Size - Adjust aimbot radius (330 default)
Smoothness - Aim smoothing control
Show FOV - Visual FOV circle
Rainbow FOV - Animated rainbow circle
Closest Body Part - Auto-target nearest body part
Use Left Mouse - Left-click aim key
Max Distance - Aimbot range (5000 default)
Wall Check - Don't target through walls
Movement Features
Noclip - Walk through walls
Visual Features
Fullbright - Remove darkness
Fullbright Strength - Brightness control (0-100%)
UI Settings
Text Size - ESP text size (8-24px)
Box Thickness - Box line width (1-5px)
Tracer Thickness - Tracer line width (1-5px)
ESP Transparency - Visibility control (0-100%)
Max Distance - ESP render distance
ESP FPS - Performance vs quality
Advanced ESP Features
Item Scanning - Detect and highlight items
Corpse Detection - Track dead players
C4 Detection - Show explosives
Weapon Tracking - See equipped weapons
Performance Optimization - Separate scan intervals
Controls
Right Click/T Key - Aimbot activation
Custom Keybinds - Configurable controls
Real-time Updates - Live ESP refresh
